We are sorry to hear about your experience and appreciate the opportunity to clarify our prescription process.

For safety and to ensure prescriptions are issued on time, we ask patients to request repeat medication at least 7 working days before it is due. This timeframe allows our clinical team to complete the required checks and for the pharmacy to dispense the medication. 

We understand this can sometimes feel longer than expected, and we are continuously working to make this process as smooth as possible which includes ordering repeat prescriptions via the NHS Wales App and the introduction of electronic prescriptions which now sends your prescription to a nominated pharmacy instantly. 

We’re also very sorry if you feel your interaction with our reception team came across as rude or unhelpful. This is not the standard of service we aim to provide, and your comments will be shared with the team so we can address this appropriately and support further training where needed.

If you were given conflicting information regarding the timing of your request, we apologise for any confusion. Please visit the surgery website which contains information on the NHS Wales App and our prescription ordering process.
